name: FNCE 5895
title: Special Topics in Finance
description: Faculty-student interaction on a one-to-one basis involving independent study of specific areas of finance, risk and insurance, and/or real estate and urban economic studies. Emphasis, selected by the student, may be on theoretical or applied aspects. A written report is required. May be repeated for a total of 12 credits.
requirement_description: FNCE 5101 or FNCE 5182; open to MBA students, others with consent.
